criteria.summary: Observed attestation bytes and runtime replay/key-ring configuration are bound to the environment and candidate by verifier-computed digests.
Signature, validity window, environment, owner, candidate digest and configuration digest are fail-closed and covered by positive and negative tests.
Disposable PostgreSQL proves the effective runtime role, schema/table, exact CRUD grants and forbidden ownership/DDL privileges.
API and worker retain pre-bind/pre-claim barriers; missing PostgreSQL replay configuration, readiness or guard rejects startup.
Two independent PostgreSQL pools preserve one-winner atomic replay claims and store failures deny access.
Redacted local command and raw-artifact receipts are reproducible and are sealed by the final candidate manifest and verifier.
Production explicitly requires the PostgreSQL adapter and an active replay guard; disabling either fails closed with no memory fallback.
